name: Clearpath Husky A300 Manipulator Package
summary: Clearpath's rugged four-wheel outdoor base Husky A300 (100 kg payload, IP54) in its preconfigured manipulator package with a Franka Research 3 arm and a ROS 2 / MoveIt 2 interface, aimed at research and tele-operated mobile manipulation.

germany.statusNote: Génération Robots lists a "Husky AMP Manipulator" configuration on its Husky A300 page and the Husky manipulation package among its mobile manipulators, but prices only the base (from 22,500 € net, 11 weeks); the arm version is on quote.

sellers.name: Generation Robots
sellers.note: Base Husky A300 from 22,500 € excl. VAT (27,000 € incl. VAT), "Delivery within 11 weeks"; the AMP Manipulator configuration is described but not priced ("Ask for a quote").

specs.label: Base max payload
specs.conditions: base platform; the arm counts towards it

specs.label: Runtime
specs.conditions: standard battery; upgraded 16 h, extended 24 h; base figure

specs.label: Max incline
specs.quote: Capable of climbing inclines of up to 30°

specs.label: Arm in the package
specs.value: Franka Research 3 manipulator with control box

notes: IP54, runtime and payload are base figures; no rating is given for the arm on the base.
Drive options: rugged four-wheel drive, casters or Mecanum wheels.
Clearpath also builds custom Husky A300 arms set-ups, for example with a Universal Robots UR5e (blog, April 2026).

images.alt: Clearpath Husky A300 mobile base, a yellow and black four-wheel platform (the manipulator package adds an arm on top)

evidence.task: Maker lists autonomous inspection and remote tele-operated mobile manipulation as example applications of the package
Custom Husky A300 with a UR5e arm built for advanced mobile manipulation research
evidence.note: A UR5e build, not the Franka package; shows Clearpath integrating arms on the A300.

researchEvidence.quote: Whether it’s rocky terrain, hills, mud, sand or inclement weather, Husky is up for the challenge.
